description: Checks a filled landlord gas safety record (CP12) or a boiler commissioning record and lists errors and warnings: missing required fields, failed tightness, flue, ventilation or safety device checks, CO/CO2 ratio over the limits, gas rate off the rated input, meter pressure out of range, an unsafe appliance marked safe, and the correct next due date (keeping the anniversary for checks done up to 2 months early). Gas safety record fields: property_address, landlord_name, landlord_address, engineer_name, gas_safe_registration_number, engineer_licence_number, check_date, previous_record_expiry_date, next_check_due, engineer_signature, tightness_test_passed, emergency_control_accessible, meter_standing_pressure_mbar, meter_working_pressure_mbar, appliances[] {type, make, model, location, flue_type, flue_check_passed, ventilation_satisfactory, safety_devices_ok, co_ppm, co2_percent, co_co2_ratio, rated_heat_input_kw_gross, measured_gas_rate_m3_h, inlet_working_pressure_mbar, status (safe, ncs, at_risk, immediately_dangerous), safe_to_use, action_taken}. Commissioning fields: property_address, engineer_name, commissioning_date, boiler_type, system_flushed, inhibitor_added, inhibitor_name, filter_fitted, water_hardness_ppm, scale_reducer_fitted, condensate_external_pipe_mm, controls_time_and_temperature, combi_extra_measure, co_alarm_fitted, building_regs_notified, dhw_flow_l_min, dhw_temp_rise_c, appliances[] {make, model, serial_number, co_ppm, co2_percent, min_rate {co_ppm, co2_percent}, rated_heat_input_kw_gross, measured_gas_rate_m3_h}. Up to 30 appliances.

trade.description: Optional. The plumber or heating engineer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1, the same shape as Spark Pack and Nero Work). Used to prefill records and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Flow Pack.

categories.description: Trades offered, using Nero Work trade names. Defaults to ["plumber", "heating"].

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Northside Plumbing & Heating".

licence_body.description: Registration scheme. For gas work use gas_safe with the business's Gas Safe registration number.

licence_number.description: Scheme registration number (Gas Safe registration numbers are usually 6 or 7 digits).

name: check_gas_record
title: Check a gas safety record or commissioning record before issuing it
